query: SELECT id AS "id!: ContactId" FROM ((SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE partner_id = $1 AND COALESCE(status = $2, $2 IS NULL) AND (id > $5) AND ($5 IS NOT NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_flags f WHERE f.contact_id = contacts.id) >= $3) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $4) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE partner_id = $1 AND COALESCE(status = $2, $2 IS NULL) AND ($5 IS NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_flags f WHERE f.contact_id = contacts.id) >= $3) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $4) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $4) __ids ORDER BY id ASC
